name: agentledger-cli
description: Local-first cost ledger for AI coding agents. Twelve agents — Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, Kilo, DSH, OpenClaw, pi-agent, Cherry Studio, CodeBuddy CN, Lingma, WorkBuddy — read from the logs they already write to your disk. Tokens and dollars, priced per token bucket. 5-hour billing blocks. No cloud, no API keys, no network calls.

scripts.sync-docs: node bin/agentledger.js aggregate > digests/samples/latest.json && node tools/sync-docs.mjs && node bin/digest.js digests/samples/latest.json docs/digest.html
scripts.verify: npm run lint && node tools/sync-docs.mjs && HOME=/nonexistent-for-tests npm test
